name: install_selftest_gate
bt_reset
sql: delete from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id in ('r5','r7','r10','nf5','nf7','nf10'); select 1 ok

name: regression_full
sql: select r.run_id, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where not exists (select 1 from ten280_bot.alerts o where o.mode='backtest' and o.run_id=replace(r.run_id,'r','bt') and o.fixture_id=r.fixture_id and o.side_id=r.side_id and o.eval_at=r.eval_at)) not_in_old from ten280_bot.alerts r where r.mode='backtest' and r.run_id in ('r5','r7','r10') group by 1 order by 1

name: split_by_tier
sql: select run_id, tier, count(*) alerts, count(distinct fixture_id) matches, count(*) filter (where cur_price < 1.30) below_130 from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id in ('bt5','bt7','bt10','nf5','nf7','nf10') group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: detect_delay
sql: select tier, cur_src, count(*) n, percentile_cont(array[0.5,0.9]) within group (order by extract(epoch from eval_at - cur_at)) secs from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id='nf5' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: sample_below130
sql: select message from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id='nf5' and cur_price < 1.30 order by eval_at desc limit 2

name: startup_v2
format_test
delivery
sql: select ten280_bot.settle(); select e.id, e.kind, e.delivery, r.status_code, (r.content::jsonb -> 'result' ->> 'text') = (e.detail ->> 'text') as text_identical, r.content::jsonb -> 'result' ->> 'text' as echoed from ten280_bot.events e left join net._http_response r on r.id = e.net_request_id where e.kind in ('startup_v2','format_test') order by e.id

name: events_all
sql: select id, kind, delivery, created_at from ten280_bot.events order by id

name: cron_job
sql: select jobname, active from cron.job where jobname = 'ten280-bet105-drop-bot'

name: live_since
sql: select id, eval_at, cur_src, sent_at, move_delay_s, delivery, message from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='live' order by id
